integrity: The general reversal criterion is proved by exact monotone reparameterization. The finite boundary is exhaustively certified by two independent constructions of the complete Venn-signature domain, with all comparisons performed using exact rational arithmetic and Ochiai compared through its square.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to binary pairwise community similarity, positive-overlap Venn signatures, and the standard Jaccard and Ochiai coefficients. The finite cutoff is by gamma richness for each comparison separately and does not address abundance-weighted, functional, or phylogenetic extensions.
title: Jaccard–Ochiai similarity first strictly reverses at five species
